```{r}
library(data.table)

library(htmlwidgets)    
```

```{r}
canada_perf <- fread("/Users/user/ookla-analytics-project/canada_performance.csv")

glimpse(canada_perf)
```

```{r}
bc_data <- canada_perf %>%
  filter(
    latitude >= 48 & latitude <= 60,
    longitude >= -139 & longitude <= -114
  )
```

```{r}
# Dataset overview
colnames(bc_data)

# Quick description of each column
data.frame(
  Column = names(bc_data),
  Type = sapply(bc_data, class),
  Missing_Values = sapply(bc_data, function(x) sum(is.na(x))),
  Sample_Value = sapply(bc_data, function(x) as.character(x[1]))
)
```

```{r}
# 1. Fast rough BC bounding box filter1
bc_bbox <- canada_perf %>%
  filter(
    latitude >= 48.25 & latitude <= 60.00,
    longitude >= -139.10 & longitude <= -114.05
  )

# 2. Convert filtered points to spatial points
bc_points <- st_as_sf(
  bc_bbox,
  coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
)

# 3. Load Canadian province boundaries
canada_provinces <- ne_states(country = "Canada", returnclass = "sf")

# 4. Isolate British Columbia boundary
bc_boundary <- canada_provinces %>%
  filter(name == "British Columbia")

# 5. Keep only rows truly inside BC
bc_data <- st_join(bc_points, bc_boundary, join = st_within) %>%
  filter(!is.na(name)) %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

# 6. Check result
cat("Rows in rough BC bbox:", nrow(bc_bbox), "\n")
cat("Rows inside true BC boundary:", nrow(bc_data), "\n")

summary(bc_data$latitude)
summary(bc_data$longitude)
```

```{r}
install.packages(
  "rnaturalearthhires",
  repos = "https://ropensci.r-universe.dev"
)
```

```{r}

bc_map_data <- bc_data %>%
  mutate(
    speed_category = case_when(
      avg_d_kbps >= 150000 ~ "Excellent: 150+ Mbps",
      avg_d_kbps >= 80000  ~ "Strong: 80-150 Mbps",
      avg_d_kbps >= 30000  ~ "Moderate: 30-80 Mbps",
      TRUE ~ "Weak: <30 Mbps"
    ),
    point_radius = case_when(
      tests >= 500 ~ 6,
      tests >= 200 ~ 5,
      tests >= 50  ~ 4,
      TRUE ~ 3
    )
  )

speed_pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = c("darkgreen", "green", "orange", "red"),
  levels = c(
    "Excellent: 150+ Mbps",
    "Strong: 80-150 Mbps",
    "Moderate: 30-80 Mbps",
    "Weak: <30 Mbps"
  )
)

# Save map as object
bc_map <- leaflet(bc_map_data) %>%
  
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%
  
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~longitude.x,
    lat = ~latitude.x,
    radius = ~point_radius,
    stroke = TRUE,
    weight = 0.3,
    color = "white",
    fillColor = ~speed_pal(speed_category),
    fillOpacity = 0.65,
    
    popup = ~paste(
      "<b>Download:</b>", round(avg_d_kbps / 1000, 1), "Mbps",
      "<br><b>Upload:</b>", round(avg_u_kbps / 1000, 1), "Mbps",
      "<br><b>Latency:</b>", round(avg_lat_ms, 1), "ms",
      "<br><b>Tests:</b>", tests,
      "<br><b>Devices:</b>", devices
    )
  ) %>%
  
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = speed_pal,
    values = ~speed_category,
    title = "Download Speed",
    opacity = 0.9
  ) %>%
  
  addControl(
    html = "<b>BC Mobile Network Performance</b><br>Ookla speed test points inside BC",
    position = "topleft"
  )

# Display map
bc_map

# Save interactive HTML widget
saveWidget(
  bc_map,
  file = "/Users/user/Desktop/Project/Network/bc_mobile_network_map.html",
  selfcontained = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
bc_latency_data <- bc_data %>%
  mutate(
    latency_category = case_when(
      avg_lat_ms <= 20 ~ "Excellent: <20 ms",
      avg_lat_ms <= 40 ~ "Good: 20-40 ms",
      avg_lat_ms <= 70 ~ "Moderate: 40-70 ms",
      TRUE ~ "High: 70+ ms"
    ),
    point_radius = case_when(
      tests >= 500 ~ 6,
      tests >= 200 ~ 5,
      tests >= 50  ~ 4,
      TRUE ~ 3
    )
  )

latency_pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = c("darkgreen", "green", "orange", "red"),
  levels = c(
    "Excellent: <20 ms",
    "Good: 20-40 ms",
    "Moderate: 40-70 ms",
    "High: 70+ ms"
  )
)

bc_latency_map <- leaflet(bc_latency_data) %>%
  
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%
  
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~longitude.x,
    lat = ~latitude.x,
    radius = ~point_radius,
    stroke = TRUE,
    weight = 0.3,
    color = "white",
    fillColor = ~latency_pal(latency_category),
    fillOpacity = 0.65,
    
    popup = ~paste(
      "<b>Latency:</b>", round(avg_lat_ms, 1), "ms",
      "<br><b>Download:</b>", round(avg_d_kbps / 1000, 1), "Mbps",
      "<br><b>Upload:</b>", round(avg_u_kbps / 1000, 1), "Mbps",
      "<br><b>Tests:</b>", tests,
      "<br><b>Devices:</b>", devices
    )
  ) %>%
  
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = latency_pal,
    values = ~latency_category,
    title = "Latency",
    opacity = 0.9
  ) %>%
  
  addControl(
    html = "<b>BC Mobile Network Latency</b><br>Lower latency indicates faster network response",
    position = "topleft"
  )

bc_latency_map

saveWidget(
  bc_latency_map,
  file = "/Users/user/Desktop/Project/Network/bc_mobile_latency_map.html",
  selfcontained = TRUE
)
```
